en: I don't mean looks. I'm talking about fashion. This place is the cutting edge of style.
But everyone has different tastes in clothes. Girls won't wear something they don't like, even if it is supposed to be in fashion.
I suppose. If that's the case, all Tokyo girls just have a great sense of style.
Yeah, I guess. People wear what they feel suits them. Maybe that's proof they're serious about fashion.
What suits them, huh? I've never given it a lot of thought, but maybe I should try that myself.
You can't ignore it. Even if you don't follow fashion trends, you'd still want to avoid clothes that look bad.
Oh, that's probably true. Girls from the 'burbs always seem to buy weird clothes from Harajuku.
'Burbs...?
Did you know that Karaokekan has a special solo karaoke room?
Seriously!? No way, tell me more!
They use a professional grade condenser mic for recording, along with headphones to listen to the karaoke track. It's perfect for practicing.
You can even rent pro-grade monitoring headphones. Two people can use the setup simultaneously, so it's useful for practicing harmonies as well.
The room is also set up like a true studio environment, so you really get high quality data of your vocal and music tracks.
That's amazing! I have to check it out sometime. I'm a major karaoke fan, you know.
Yeah, you should check it out.
Speaking of which, I go by myself when they have all-you-can-sing deals in the afternoon.
Really? That's amazing you can sing that long.
I know, right? But when I went back for their all-you-can-sing in the evening, they turned me away!
Of course. If you take up a whole room just for yourself, you'll keep the larger parties away.
Well, I have a ton of songs on my phone, so when I have time I always try to learn them.
You're quite dedicated.
I can also check the lyrics on my screen, so I can do karaoke pretty much anywhere as long as I have my phone!
Just make sure you don't drain your battery and miss important calls.
Oh, and guess what? Last time I was at karaoke I ran into a total stud at the drink machine.
Makes sense. Waiting in line is a good opportunity to meet other customers.
Yeah, so he was all, "What do you want to drink?" without me even asking! He was super nice!
Uh, I think he was just trying to hit on you.
You think? I do fall for people just on their voice a lot.
You have a voice fetish?
Oh yeah! I'll get really into someone 'cause of it. Not just at concerts or clubs either, but at karaoke too.
Hm. Someone with good pipes can make any song sound great. I'm a bit jealous.
Kiryu-san, didn't we talk about this already?
Huh? Did we?
Let's talk about something else.
Did you know takoyaki can help with fatigue?
Yeah. Octopus is rich in taurine and zinc, which is good for recovering from exhaustion.
Wow, I'd never have guessed.
In Kansai, they have Hangesho on July 2nd, eleven days after the summer solstice.
It's tradition to eat octopus then, and has even been designated as Octopus Day.
Whoa, neat! Next time I'm tired from work, I should get some takoyaki on my way home!
It's also great for ladies, since it's easy to eat.
Come to think of it, I feel like I order takoyaki a lot when I'm out at karaoke.
Ah, from their snack menu.
Hey, next time I get tired from singing, I'll just order up some takoyaki for an energy boost!
You really sing yourself to the point of exhaustion?
Hmm, maybe I should try that instead of liver sashimi!
That sounds good. It pairs well with a highball, too. It's a great cocktail hors d'oeuvre.
Do you think takoyaki pairs with black tea?
Not sure. I'd think it would go better with green tea.
I think it'd go great with iced lemon tea! I'll have to give it a try!
You really like trying new things, huh?
Oh, but takoyaki is pretty high in calories, isn't it?
Come on, Kiryu-san, stop trying to mess with my diet!
I heard a big thing lately is tea salons that serve edible tea.
Oh, that's a new one! Tell me more!
They don't just cook tea leaves or mix them in with sweets, but they make tea syrups and steak sauces to serve along with food.
Since the food naturally pairs well with tea, drinking it together enhances the flavor.
Oh, neat! So the food itself is prepared to compliment the tea? That sounds delicious!
I imagine it'd smell really good. It'd probably fill the kitchen with a pleasantly sweet aroma.
I'll need to think up some recipes! I've made lots of sweets that include black tea, but main dishes would be a first. Sounds like fun!
Don't worry, when I make it, I'll for sure let you taste it!
Heh. I'm looking forward to it.
I feel like I've put on some weight lately, but hearing about this really makes me want to give it a try!
Ugh, and I've been wanting to go on a diet, too! Kiryu-san, you jerk!
When it comes to enjoying tea, you should pay attention to the tableware too.
Oh no. I wonder if I should've put in a bid for that dining set after all.
I'm sure another one will be put up for auction eventually.
Yeah. I'll have to keep an eye out so I can snatch it up as fast as possible.
Just don't do it here at work.
Oh, speaking of tea salons! I went to this place the other day where I got served by a super-hottie of a waiter!
He had the mannerisms of the ultimate butler⑬he was a total Jeeves! And he had this white hair that was just so unexpectedly gorgeous!
You mean he was a super-hot grandpa...?
With the recent Korean pop culture boom, I've heard Korean saunas are becoming pretty popular among women.
Oh? How's it different from a regular sauna?
They're called hanjeungmak. It's a domed room, made of maifan stone.
It actually warms your body from within, improving blood circulation, which helps prevent illnesses. It's also good for recovering from exhaustion.
Really? I've been feeling tired lately, so maybe I should give it a go sometime!
Then you'll be happy to know that you don't need to go to Korea to enjoy one. We have some nearby.
My commute is an hour each way, so my feet get super tired if I can't get a seat on the train.
Maybe after the sauna I can get a massage too!
Yeah, that'd melt the exhaustion away for sure.
So hey, doesn't black tea after getting out of a sauna sound good?
Because your body is left dehydrated, anything would be good to drink, I'd think.
Yeah, true. I'll try it out next time!
Tea is a diuretic, so you're better off going for plain water, I think.
Is that good for dieting as well as recovering from exhaustion?
Naturally. It'll cleanse your body of toxins and improve your metabolism, like a beauty treatment.
Really!? Well, then I'm going!
I'm glad I've sparked your interest.
Oh, so hey! Will a sauna make my boobs bigger?
No. I think you'll lose weight and they'll become smaller.
What? Then there's no point!
Where'd that come from all of a sudden?
That one girl I mentioned before, her boobs are so huge, she can rest them on the table! I wish mine were as big as hers.
I honestly don't know what to say to that.
I've heard there's a famous brand outlet store that's been really popular lately.
An outlet? I don't feel like going out of my way to buy stuff that's old.
But this place gets the newest items, including the latest in Parisian couture, right after it's announced.
So depending on your timing, you can get things while they're still hot at an affordable price.
Oh wow, color me intrigued! If I can get designer clothing cheap, I'm definitely going!
And since it comes right from the designer, you don't need to worry about knockoffs.
I don't buy clothes, usually. I'd rather buy something cheap that looks like designer clothing, instead of something expensive.
That's not a bad idea. It's not just about status, but your sense of style. Your way of thinking demonstrates your fashion savvy.
See, you get me, Kiryu-san! Though, I would love to own some nice clothes.
If I wore nothing but designer clothing, I wouldn't be turned away from a host club, right?
I think they'd be more than happy to have you.
Hehe, for sure! I'll give it a shot sometime.
You want to go back there that badly?
By the way, if you want great deals on clothing, you should try online auctions.
I see. Depending on how much you bid to win the auction, you could end up getting a great deal.
Yep! But since you can't check out the item before you buy it, you can sometimes get something completely different than the auction photo.
That's a total scam. It may even be worth the trouble to report them.
I think it's best to take a guy shopping first, to see if he's the abusive type.
Oh, why's that?
Abusive men won't help me pick things out or carry my stuff, and they'll be totally rude to the shop staff.
I see. Since women take more time to shop, it's a good chance to see the guy's true colors.
I'd really love a guy who didn't let his impatience show and stuck it out with the shopping.
Do you mind telling me what you like?
What I like? As in...?
Hmm. I guess tripe?
Oh, and I've been pretty into shellfish lately!
Shellfish?
Yeah, the kind you get at the convenience store. Snacks for drinking, like scallops and whelk.
I like those too. They've got a crunchy texture that makes them addicting.
Right! When I'm feeling peckish, I'll nibble on some. Before I know it, I'll have polished off an entire bag. So I have to be careful.
I know how that goes. I bet you and I could have a great night out drinking.
Young women don't usually go for that stuff. Is there a reason you like it so much?
I guess I got into it when I was out for sushi, and realized how tasty it was.
I see. Then you must like shellfish when you go out for sushi, too.
Yeah! I even like shellfish more than toro!
I see. I'll have to remember that.
What don't you like?
Green peppers!
Wow, that was fast. I guess lots of women don't.
And tomatoes! And carrots! Oh, and broccoli, celery... Asparagus too!
So... vegetables? That's not good for your health. Vegetables have important nutrients.
Don't worry about it. I drink vegetable juice, so I'm A-OK.
Hm. I guess.
What kind of music do you listen to?
I like rock.
Me too. I sing it a lot at karaoke.
No, this is different! I'm into visual kei.
Visual kei? Ah, those bands with crazy hair, makeup, and costumes. That was the rage for a while, huh? I'm not too familiar with that era.
No, they're totally still around! If you don't know about them, you don't need to pretend.
There sure are lots of kinds of rock music, huh?
That's not my style. I'm into soulful music, like the blues.
Haha, that's perfect! That's so you, Kiryu-san. You have to sing some for me next time!
What do you want most right now?
Hmm. I guess some clothes?
What kind of clothes?
Just everyday clothes, really. I don't have a lot of variety in my wardrobe, so more choices will let me mix and match.
Ah. I always wear the same stuff, but I guess it's a little different for women.
I don't really have many, but if I had to say, I guess I'm into watching movies.
Oh? Do you go to the movies a lot?
Not really, but I do rent them a bunch.
Rentals, huh? So you mostly watch movies at home?
Yeah. But I watch the same films over and over. I don't really have a lot of knowledge about movies.
That makes sense. It's nice to see a wide variety of films, but you can still be a movie buff just by rewatching famous movies.
If I like a movie, I'll watch it again and again, until I have all the lines memorized!
That's impressive. I'll only rewatch a movie if I accidentally rent one I've already seen.
Haha! Yeah, when I rent things, the clerk will look at my rental history and be all, "You've already rented this, miss."
How do you respond to that?
With, "Yeah, what about it?" If I like something, why can't I watch it multiple times?
That doesn't get old? Maybe it'd be good to try watching some other films.
It's not like I always watch the same thing. It's only every few months that I'll decide to rent something I feel like seeing again.
So you watch something completely different on other occasions?
I mean, I have more than one movie I like. I try to rotate through them, but I wind up wanting to watch the first one I see anyways.
But that's just the same set of films over and over.
If you like them so much, buy them. DVDs are cheap these days, so it's more expensive to keep renting them.
